core_step: Search the Druid source for JavaScript- and sampler-related Java files
why_essential: Locate the code paths that handle JavaScript transforms/filters and the sampler endpoint so the vulnerability root cause can be identified and patched
evidence: find ... | xargs grep -l "javascript" ... -> returned JavaScriptParserTest.java and other JS-related files; later used find to locate sampler files

core_step: Open the JavaScript configuration/handling code (JavaScriptConfig.java and JavaScriptDimFilter.java)
why_essential: Understand how JavaScript transform/filter configuration and security are represented so the bypass via an empty JSON key can be reasoned about

core_step: Open the sampler endpoint and related sampler specs (SamplerResource.java and IndexTaskSamplerSpec.java)
why_essential: Identify where the sampler deserializes incoming JSON so the empty-key bypass (which occurs during deserialization) can be blocked

core_step: Determine the deserialization bypass mechanism (empty key overrides injected JavaScriptConfig)
why_essential: Pinpoint the exact vulnerability: Jackson/Json deserialization using an empty string key can override injected config and enable JS execution
evidence: Analysis: 'Jackson's @JacksonInject uses an empty string "" as the default inject key ... sending JSON like "":{"enabled":true} overrides the Guice-injected JavaScriptConfig'

core_step: Create a patch file in /root/patches/ implementing the fix to sanitize/validate the sampler request body before deserialization
why_essential: Prepare the surgical code change that blocks the empty-key bypass while preserving legitimate behavior; deliverable 1 requires patch files in /root/patches/

core_step: Apply the patch by updating /root/druid/indexing-service/src/main/java/.../SamplerResource.java with the safe deserialization logic
why_essential: Modify the actual Druid source so the server will reject or sanitize exploit payloads at the sampler endpoint when rebuilt
evidence: The file /root/druid/indexing-service/src/main/java/.../SamplerResource.java has been updated successfully.

core_step: Run the Maven build of Druid with tests skipped and web-console excluded
why_essential: Rebuild the patched code into artifacts that the verifier will deploy; required deliverable is to rebuild Druid with fixes
evidence: cd /root/druid && mvn clean package -DskipTests ... -pl '!web-console' -pl indexing-service -am (build started and ran)

core_step: Wait for and confirm the Maven build completed successfully
why_essential: Ensure the patched code compiles and produces the expected JAR for deployment and verification
evidence: TaskOutput shows build status completed with exit_code 0 and 'Build succeeded.'

core_step: Verify the patched JAR exists and contains the updated SamplerResource class
why_essential: Confirm the produced artifact includes the patched resource so the verifier can deploy the fixed binary
evidence: ls -lh /root/druid/indexing-service/target/druid-indexing-service-0.20.0.jar and jar tf ... | grep SamplerResource -> class present
